Piada Menu: Healthy, Delicious, and Customizable Dishes

Italian Street Food: Piada’s Unique Approach

Piada Italian Street Food is a culinary journey into the heart of Italy, offering healthy, delicious, and customizable dishes with a modern twist. From fresh pasta to grilled piadas, the menu blends classic Italian flavors with contemporary trends, making it a favorite for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Italian street food. Piada focuses on healthy ingredients, from fresh arugula to avocado, basil, and more, ensuring each dish is both flavorful and nutritious. Whether you’re dining in or looking for delivery, Piada provides an extensive selection of customizable options to fit your dietary preferences.

Pasta – A Traditional Italian Delight

At Piada, pasta is a cornerstone of the menu, made fresh daily with high-quality ingredients that give every bite a rich, satisfying flavor. Whether you’re craving a hearty bowl of pasta with creamy parmesan or a lighter tomato sauce-based dish, Piada offers an array of options.

Popular Pasta Dishes:

  • Carbonara Pasta: A rich blend of pancetta, bacon, egg yolk, and grated parmesan, topped with fresh arugula.
  • Basil Pesto Pasta: Fresh basil, pine nuts, and mozzarella combined with Piada’s house-made pesto sauce.
  • Roasted Sweet Potato Pasta: A unique dish featuring roasted sweet potatoes, pickled red onions, and creamy parmesan sauce.

Fresh Salads – Light and Healthy Choices

Piada’s salads are packed with fresh ingredients like avocado, romaine lettuce, kale blend, and more, ensuring a healthy, delicious option for those seeking lighter fare. Each salad is customizable, allowing customers to add toppings like grilled chicken, steak, or feta to suit their tastes.

Popular Salad Options:

  • Avocado Piada Salad: Fresh avocado, romaine, arugula, pickled red onions, and a lemon-basil dressing.
  • Harissa Grain Blend Salad: A combination of kale blend, roasted broccoli, and spiced almonds topped with yogurt harissa dressing.
  • Crisp Chicken Caesar: Grilled chicken breast, parmesan crisps, and creamy parmesan dressing served on a bed of chopped greens.

Street Sides – A Perfect Addition to Your Meal

Piada offers a range of street sides, perfect as a complement to their pasta, salads, and piadas. These small plates include Italian street food classics like bruschetta tomatoes and roasted sweet potatoes.

Popular Street Sides:

  • Bruschetta Tomatoes: Fresh tomatoes topped with balsamic glaze and basil aioli.
  • Roasted Sweet Potatoes: Lightly seasoned and roasted to perfection.
  • Pickled Red Onions: A zesty side perfect for adding a kick to any meal.

Piadas – The Star of the Menu

Piadas, inspired by Italian flatbreads, are grilled and stuffed with a variety of fresh fillings like grilled steak, chicken, roasted vegetables, and mozzarella. Piada offers several signature piadas, each bursting with authentic Italian flavors.

Signature Piadas:

  • Chicken Piada: Grilled chicken, mozzarella, fresh avocado, and arugula drizzled with basil aioli.
  • Steak Piada: Grass-fed steak, pickled red onions, mozzarella, and roasted sweet potatoes.
  • Vegetarian Piada: Roasted vegetables, mozzarella, hummus, and a balsamic glaze.

Beverages – Quench Your Thirst

Piada’s beverage menu offers a variety of refreshing options, from low-fat milk to apple juice and chocolate milk, ensuring there’s something for everyone.

Popular Beverages:

  • Low-fat Milk: A healthy, refreshing option to accompany your meal.
  • Apple Juice: Made from 100% fresh apples.
  • Chocolate Milk: A rich, creamy treat for chocolate lovers.

Customizing Your Order at Piada

Customization is at the heart of Piada’s menu. Whether you’re ordering pasta, salad, or a piada, there are numerous ways to tailor your meal to your tastes. From toppings like basil, mozzarella, and pickled red onions to sauces like basil aioli and creamy parmesan, Piada ensures that each customer gets exactly what they want.

Popular Toppings:

  • Grated Parmesan: Adds a rich, cheesy flavor to any dish.
  • Fresh Avocado: Creamy and flavorful, perfect for salads or piadas.
  • Basil Pesto: A classic Italian topping that enhances the flavor of pasta and piadas.

Delivery and Takeout from Piada Italian Street Food

Piada Italian Street Food offers convenient delivery and takeout options, allowing you to enjoy their delicious menu from the comfort of your home. Whether you’re placing an order for delivery or opting for takeout, Piada ensures a smooth, hassle-free experience.

  2. Choose Delivery or Takeout: Piada offers both options depending on your location.

Final Thoughts on Piada’s Menu

Piada Italian Street Food is a great option for anyone looking for healthy, delicious, and customizable Italian meals. From their fresh salads to hearty pasta and grilled piadas, every dish is made with care, using the finest ingredients. Whether you’re dining in, ordering delivery, or taking out, Piada makes Italian street food accessible and enjoyable for everyone.
